body:
## Research findings

### 1. Control mode and program header
Brother CNC-C00 (S500X2, S700X2) and CNC-D00 run both conversational mode and Fanuc-like NC language.
A CAM post targets NC language because the control imports plain-text ISO files via USB or RS-232.
- Emit `%` at start and end.
- Emit a 4-digit `O` program number (`O0001` to `O9999`) with an optional comment.
- Emit `G20` or `G21` on its own line from document units (`crates/app/src/posting.rs`).
- Emit an explicit safety block: `G90 G17 G40 G49 G80`.
- End with safe Z retract (`G91 G28 Z0` or `G53 G0 Z0`), XY park, `G90`, `M30`, and `%`.
Sources: Brother CNC-C00/D00 Programming Manuals (`69A799001`), `assets/posts/fanuc.cps`, `docs/CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md`.

### 2. Tool change and tool data
Speedio X2 machines use a fast armless turret ATC (`14` or `21` tools; `0.7` s tool-to-tool, `1.3` s chip-to-chip).
- **Non-stop ATC (`G100`):** Emit `G100 T01 X.. Y..` then `G43 H01 Z.. S.. M03` as default, or `G100` behind a post property.
- Never put extra M-codes (except `M03`/`M04`) or unconfigured rotary axes in a `G100` block because the control alarms.
- **Standard `M06` option:** Emit `G91 G28 Z0` (or `G53 G0 Z0`), then `T01 M06` on one block without extra M-codes.
- **No standby pre-call:** Do not emit a separate Fanuc next-tool `T` block. A bare `T` indexes the turret directly without a swing-arm pot.
- **Tool table (`G43 H`):** The control stores length, wear, radius, tool life, empty-pot rules, and break-detect targets in Tool Data (`G10 L10`/`L12` also exist; `H0` is zero).
- Emit `G43 H<n>` matched to `T<n>` after each tool change, and re-apply `G43 H<n>` after `G28` or `G53` cancels offsets.
Sources: Brother CNC-C00/D00 Programming Manuals (`69A799001`), Brother `global.brother` S500X2/S700X2 specs.

### 3. High-speed modes, break detection, and coolant codes
- **High-accuracy smoothing:** CNC-C00/D00 support Mode A (`M260`–`M267`, cancel `M269`), Mode B (`M280`–`M287`, cancel `M289`), and override `M298 L<n>` / `M299` (`M298 L0` turns smoothing off).
- Map `PARAM.Smoothing` tolerance and mode (`crates/app/src/smoothing.rs`) to `M298 L<n>` / `M299` (or Mode B) cleanly, and force smoothing off (`M298 L0`) during touch probing.
- **Tool-break detection:** Optional checks use `M120`/`M121` (touch-sensor signal check) and `M200`/`M201`/`M203` (Type 2/Type 3 break-detect options). Gate break-detect calls behind opt-in post properties because hardware varies by machine.
- **Coolant and air blast:** Use `M08`/`M09` (flood), `M494`/`M495` (through-spindle coolant on/off), `M458`/`M459` (coolant/air blow on/off), and `M498`/`M499` (spindle air blow/wash on/off). Resolve codes from `machine.coolants`, refuse unsupported coolant kinds by name, and emit no coolant on probe sections.
Sources: Brother CNC-C00/TC Programming Manuals, `crates/app/src/smoothing.rs`, `assets/posts/fanuc.cps`.

### 4. Cycles and arcs
- Emit `G17`, `G18`, or `G19` and incremental `I`/`J`/`K` helical arcs (`G02`/`G03`).
- Standard cycles match `G73`, `G81`, `G82`, `G83`, `G85`, `G86`, and `G89` with `G98`/`G99` and `G80`.
- **Brother rigid tapping (`G77`/`G78`):** Emit `G77` (right-hand) or `G78` (left-hand): `G77 G99 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ I_ Q_ S_ L_`.
- Put thread pitch (`FeedRate / SpindleSpeed`) in `I` (or TPI in `J` if inch TPI mode is chosen), and omit `F` and `M29`. Emit `Q` for positive peck depth and optional `L` for high-speed return RPM.
- Use `G84`/`G74` only when `TappingMode` is `floating` (if supported), or refuse floating taps by name.
Sources: Brother CNC-C00/TC Programming Manuals, `crates/app/tests/golden/tap_plate.cl`, `crates/post/src/post/cnc.rs`.

### 5. Machine data (S500X2, S700X2, and 4th-axis `T-200A`)
All data comes from Brother `global.brother` X2 specifications and CamCraft schema rules (`assets/machines/AGENTS.md`):
- **S500X2:** travel `X 500`, `Y 400`, `Z 300` mm; table `600 x 400` mm; nose-to-table `180–480` mm; max uniform table load `250` kg (`300` kg parameter option).
- **S700X2:** travel `X 700`, `Y 400`, `Z 300` mm; table `800 x 400` mm; nose-to-table `180–480` mm; max uniform table load `250` kg (`300` kg parameter option).
- **Spindle (BT30, `rigid_tapping: true`):** `"spindle_mount": "BT30"`, `"default_holder": "BT30 ER20"` (`crates/post/src/machine/tooling.rs`, `crates/tools/src/holder_library.rs`). Standard `1–10,000` rpm (`7.1` kW continuous / `10.1` kW 10-min / `18.9` kW peak); optional `1–16,000` rpm (`5.1`/`7.4`/`15.4` kW), `1–27,000` rpm (`6.3`/`8.9` kW), `1–10,000` rpm High-Torque (`9.2`/`12.8`/`26.2` kW).
- **ATC:** `14` tools standard (max length `250` mm, total `25` kg) or `21` tools optional (max length `160` mm, total `35` kg); max `3.0` kg/tool; max diameter `110` mm (adjacent pockets empty).
- **Feeds and rapids:** rapid `X 50,000`, `Y 50,000`, `Z 56,000` mm/min; max cutting feed `30,000` mm/min.
- **4th axis (`T-200A` on CNC-C00; `T-200Ad` on CNC-D00):** rotary `A` about `X`, center height `170` mm (`axis_to_table`), `70H7` mm bore, max `100` rpm (`36,000` deg/min), pneumatic clamp (`280` N*m clamp / `720` N*m holding). Brake clamp/unclamp M-codes depend on ladder/builder setup (`M10`/`M11` or `M440`–`M445`), so store brake codes per machine file or post property.

### 6. Comparison with `assets/posts/fanuc.cps`
**Already right in `fanuc.cps`:**
- Manifest flags (`coolantModes`, `afterModes`, `axisInversion`, `probeAxisInversion`, `millSpindleReverse`, `programUnits = "mm inch"`).
- `%` wrapper, 4-digit `O`-words, document-driven `G20`/`G21`.
- `machine.coolants` lookup, `M9` stop, zero coolant on probes, hop-law clearance, `G2`/`G3` `I`/`J`/`K` helical arcs, `G73`/`G81`/`G82`/`G83`/`G85`/`G86`/`G89`, and spindle-stop / missing-feed refusals.

**Must change for `brother-speedio.cps`:**
1. Emit explicit `G17` in the start safety block.
2. Emit `G100 T.. X.. Y..` + `G43 H.. Z..` (with `M06` fallback option) and omit standby next-tool `T` calls.
3. Replace `G84 F` rigid tap with `G77`/`G78` (`I` pitch, optional `Q`, optional `L`, no `F`).
4. Replace the `G5.1` comment stub in `smoothOn()` with `M298`/`M299` (or Mode B) and force smoothing off on probes.
5. Support `M494`/`M495`, `M458`/`M459`, `M498`/`M499`, `safe_retract` (`G28`/`G30`/`G53`), `explains` comments (`#1386`), and explicit `A0` after tool changes plus separate-block clamp M-codes on 4th-axis machines (like `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps`).

---

## Design proposal (smallest useful slice first)
1. **Slice 1 — Core 3-axis post (`brother-speedio.cps`):** Ship NC-language posting with `G100`/`M06`, `G77`/`G78`, `G17`, standard cycles/arcs, coolant resolution, `explains`, and full golden/script test coverage.
2. **Slice 2 — Base 3-axis machines (`S500X2`, `S700X2`):** Add `.mch` definitions mapped directly to `brother-speedio.cps` with no throwaway intermediate mapping.
3. **Slice 3 — High-accuracy smoothing, air blow, and break detect:** Wire `M298`/`M299` (and Mode A/B), `M498`/`M499` spindle air blow, and opt-in `M120`/`M200`–`M203` break checks.
4. **Slice 4 — Optional 4th axis (`T-200A`):** Add 4th-axis `.mch` variants and safe `A`-axis indexing, explicit initial `A0`, and configurable clamp/unclamp M-codes.
5. **Slice 5 — Shop air-cut test kit:** Add a runnable `.camproj`, verified `.nc`, and dry-run guide under `docs/tester-kits/`.

---

## Proposed sub-issues
1. **Posts: Brother Speedio core 3-axis mill post (brother-speedio.cps)**
   Add `assets/posts/brother-speedio.cps` for Brother NC language with `G100`/`M06` tool changes, `G77`/`G78` rigid tapping, `G17` preamble, coolant lookup, and `explains`.
   `Done means:` `brother-speedio.cps` is in `BUILTINS`, posts all 13 `GOLDENS` in `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs`, and passes `script_brother_speedio.rs` and `brother_speedio_post.rs`.
   Labels: `P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`, `enhancement`, `source:agent`

2. **Machines: Brother Speedio S500X2 and S700X2 (BT30, CNC-C00)**
   Add `assets/machines/brother-s500x2.mch` and `assets/machines/brother-s700x2.mch` with verified travels, BT30 spindle, 14-tool ATC, rapids, feeds, and coolants.
   `Done means:` both `.mch` files are registered in `MACHINES`, paired with `brother-speedio.cps`, and pass `crates/app/tests/machine.rs` plus spec pinning tests.
   Labels: `P6`, `effort:medium`, `area:post`, `enhancement`, `source:agent`

3. **Posts: Brother Speedio high-accuracy smoothing (M298/M280), spindle air blow (M498), and break-detect options**
   Add CamCraft smoothing output (`M298`/`M299` or Mode A/B, forced off on probes), spindle air blow (`M498`/`M499`), and opt-in tool-breakage check properties.
   `Done means:` `brother-speedio.cps` emits and cancels smoothing per op type, supports all Brother coolant/air M-codes, gates break checks safely, and passes updated unit and golden tests.
   Labels: `P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`, `enhancement`, `source:agent`

4. **Machines & Posts: Brother Speedio S500X2/S700X2 with T-200A 4th-axis rotary support**
   Add `T-200A` 4th-axis `.mch` variants (`axis_to_table: 170` mm) and add explicit `A0` reset, separate-block clamp M-codes, and unconfigured-axis guards in `brother-speedio.cps`.
   `Done means:` 4th-axis `.mch` files validate in `machine.rs`, `brother-speedio.cps` posts 3+1 indexed ops safely, and rotary unit tests cover `A0` reset and clamping.
   Labels: `P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`, `enhancement`, `source:agent`

5. **Docs: Brother Speedio air-cut test kit for CNC-C00/D00**
   Add a clean air-cut test kit (`README.md`, `.camproj`, posted `.nc`) under `docs/tester-kits/brother-speedio/` with step-by-step dry-run checks.
   `Done means:` `docs/tester-kits/brother-speedio/` exists with `README.md`, runnable `.camproj`, verified `.nc`, and a pinning test checking that the kit posts clean.
   Labels: `P7`, `effort:medium`, `area:post`, `enhancement`, `source:agent`

Filed the research sub-issues in slice order:
1. #1980 — Core 3-axis Brother Speedio post (`brother-speedio.cps`, `P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`)
2. #1982 — Speedio S500X2 and S700X2 machine files (`P6`, `effort:medium`, `area:post`)
3. #1983 — High-accuracy smoothing (`M298`/`M299`, Mode A/B), spindle air blow (`M498`/`M499`), and opt-in break checks (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`)
4. #1985 — Speedio S500X2/S700X2 with `T-200A` 4th-axis rotary support (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`)
5. #1987 — Brother Speedio air-cut test kit (`P7`, `effort:medium`, `area:post`)

This umbrella issue stays open for maintainer review.
